description: Matchups judged by an experienced chessboxer (Val) before looking at the model, 2026-09-27. Colours not drawn. Boxing levels (named Novice … Pro at the time, since renamed): 0 Never boxed, 1 Gym boxer, 2 Regular sparrer, 3 Amateur fighter, 4 Experienced amateur, 5 Elite / Pro.

legend.favourite: A | B | even | even-B. 'clear' = lopsided, 'slight' = tough matchup, only just favourite.
legend.ending: chess = the fight usually ends at the board, boxing = usually by stoppage, long = balanced / goes deep or to the decision
legend.known_issue: true when the current model is known not to match yet; reported but does not fail the run

cases.expert: B, early win by boxing in the first boxing round
Same as 1. Knockout chance in the second boxing round about the same as in 5 rounds, maybe lower (confirmed ok with the current model)

B clear favourite, but a long fight, probably won by boxing around round 6. Chess finishing in round 5 should be rare at this level. Clarified: B is the obvious favourite, not a lopsided one; the percentage can stay low
A wins around round 5, on time at the board
B, tough matchup, B wins at the board in round 5 or 7
B wins, clear favourite, tough match
B wins in the first boxing round, boxing 0 means an easy knockout. Levels below 1 must be penalized a lot
A clear favourite for such a short fight
Very balanced fight, B small favourite
